title: Koala dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- koala body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#9AA6B2"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#C8D2DC"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="18" fill="#AEB8C2"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="26" r="10" fill="#AEB8C2"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="26" r="6" fill="#E8A0B4"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="26" r="10" fill="#AEB8C2"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="26" r="6" fill="#E8A0B4"/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#D0D8E0"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#4A3A4A"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38.5" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#7A6A7A"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="35" r="2.5" fill="#2A1A3A"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="35" r="2.5" fill="#2A1A3A"/>
  <circle cx="43.8" cy="34.3" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="57.8" cy="34.3" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M46 45 Q50 49 54 45" stroke="#4A3A4A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- dancing arms -->
  <path d="M32 62 Q20 50 18 38" stroke="#AEB8C2" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="36" r="3.5" fill="#AEB8C2"/>
  <path d="M68 62 Q80 48 84 36" stroke="#AEB8C2" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="34" r="3.5" fill="#AEB8C2"/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d="M42 84 Q36 94 30 94" stroke="#AEB8C2" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="94" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#8A96A2"/>
  <path d="M58 84 Q64 92 70 90" stroke="#AEB8C2" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="90" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#8A96A2"/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <path d="M14 22 L14 14 L20 12" stroke="#FFD24A" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="23" r="2.5" fill="#FFD24A"/>
  <path d="M82 18 L82 10 L88 8" stroke="#FF8AC4" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="19" r="2.5" fill="#FF8AC4"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#7AEAFF"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#7AEAFF"/>
</svg>
